scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: dates, keys, cells, pick and range

limitations: React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React Calendar with ui-calendar at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-06): 2 cell, gap and radius from resolveCalendar; 3 no border budget; 4 cells are squares; 5 month buttons are controls; 6 no nesting; 7 selected on the primary solid, today an inset ring; 8 density leaves cells alone; 9 no floating layer; 10 hugs 56u; 11 cells take the keyboard focus ring.
